title: Best of Norway: Oslo, Flåm and Bergen
alt: The Aurlandsfjord seen from the Flåm valley on a clear summer morning
transport: Airport transfers, the Norway in a Nutshell rail and fjord route, and the Bergen line back to Oslo

stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · City hotel on the metro, minutes from the centre

activities.name: Oslofjord sightseeing cruise
activities.description: Two hours on the water past the islands, bathing spots and wooden summer houses of the inner fjord.

program.name: Oslo
program.description: Two nights to settle in, with a fjord cruise past the islands of the inner Oslofjord.

stops.name: Flåm
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Waterside hotel at the head of the Aurlandsfjord

activities.name: Norway in a Nutshell: Flåm Railway
activities.description: One of the steepest standard-gauge railways in the world, 20 kilometres of tunnels, waterfalls and hairpin views down to the fjord.

program.name: Flåm
program.description: The classic Norway in a Nutshell day: the Bergen line to Myrdal, the Flåm Railway down the valley and a night at the fjord.

stops.name: Bergen
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Modern hotel close to the harbour and Bryggen

activities.name: Nærøyfjord cruise and Stalheim road
activities.description: Ferry through the narrowest UNESCO fjord in Norway, then the coach over the Stalheimskleiva hairpins to the Bergen train.

activities.name: Mostraumen fjord cruise
activities.description: Three hours from Bergen harbour up the Osterfjord to the tidal rapids at Mostraumen, close enough to the cliffs to fill a bottle from a waterfall.

program.name: Bergen
program.description: Three nights in the fjord capital: the Nærøyfjord crossing to get there, the Hanseatic wharf, and a cruise up the Osterfjord to the Mostraumen rapids.

expert.name: Ingrid
expert.quote: Norway is a country you travel through, not to. Let the trains and ferries do the work and the fjords arrive on their own.
expert.tip: Sit on the left side of the Flåm Railway going down. The Kjosfossen waterfall stop is on that side and the drop into the valley is far better.

summary: Eight days through the best of southern Norway: Oslo and its fjord, the Flåm Railway and Nærøyfjord on the Norway in a Nutshell route, three nights in Bergen with a cruise to the Mostraumen rapids, and the Bergen line back.
